fusions.name: Budded Blade
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A weapon strike with a blade grown from your own plating, which deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Breakwater
fusions.desc: Lays down a reef wall 5 tiles long that stands for 6 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy crossing it, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeded Spire
fusions.desc: Seeds a spire that stands for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage every second to an enemy within 4 tiles, each time with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Accreting Hull
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
